source: initializationJsonPath (environment tier) and initializationOpenAPIPath (properties-file tier) loaded at startup; the active expectations list both, in order, and GET /mockserver/config names each path with its tier. An OpenAPI expectation's id is openapi:<title>_<hash>:<operationId>, the hash being the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of specUrlOrPayload (OpenApiSyncPlanner.specKeyFromHash), here the spec's absolute path: it differs per checkout, so it is masked like a port.
